correctness.rationale: The standard sufficiently subdivided two-particle cubical deformation model applies: the dodecahedral graph girth five and essential vertex separation satisfy Abrams requirements. Rebuilt its 20 vertices, 30 edges and unordered disjoint-cell chain groups from scratch: (C0,C1,C2)=(190,540,375), connected 1-skeleton gives rank d1=189. Independently fetched actual integral certificate (Git blob 8189905fa1d8d25cb8778c0693ebcb05bb6f8f36) and verified all 36 kernel vectors have exactly zero signed d2 boundaries and identity submatrix on distinct free rows. Separately computed binary d2 rank=339; since rank over Q >= rank over F2 and the 36 independent integer cycles give rank over Q <=339, equality follows and Betti=(1,12,36). Independently regenerated all 120 graph automorphisms, center C2, the 60-element edge-even A5 factor, then all signed C0,C1,C2 traces and H2 basis traces. The eight class bins (edge-parity,rotation order,H1,H2,count) were (+,1,12,36,1),(+,2,0,-4,15),(+,3,0,0,20),(+,5,2,1,24),(-,1,0,-6,1),(-,2,-4,2,15),(-,3,0,0,20),(-,5,0,-1,24). Split by central involution and checked rational irreducible A5 character table, obtaining precisely the stated decompositions. This is exhaustive finite proof for the single 20-vertex graph, not extrapolation.
